| `fields`              | `Array<object>` | ✓        | —       | The fields: `[{ key, label, type?, hint?, placeholder?, required?, pattern?, patternMessage?, min?, max?, integer?, rows?, options?, optionsUrl?, optionsPath?, optionLabel?, optionValue?, default?, readOnly?, wide?, url?, valuePath?, saveUrl?, saveMethod?, saveKey?, saveParams?, uploadUrl?, uploadField?, uploadParams?, uploadValuePath?, initials?, initialsFrom?, visibleWhen?, trueValue?, falseValue?, setKey?, saveAs?, text?, textMap?, tone?, toneMap?, method?, send?, resultPath?, okPath?, successText?, failureText?, fill?, multiple?, keyLabel?, valueLabel?, valueType?, valueAbove?, valueMessage?, addLabel?, path?, scope? }]`. `type` is `text` (default), `textarea`, `number`, `switch`, `select`, `radio`, `checkboxes`, `pairs`, `lines`, `secret`, `image`, `heading`, `status` or `action`. A `checkboxes` field (or a `select` with `multiple`) saves its choices as a list, or with `saveAs` `json` or `csv` as JSON or comma text. A `pairs` field edits key-to-value rows and saves them as one object (JSON text with `saveAs: 'json'`); its `pattern` checks each key and `valueAbove` each value. A field with `path: 'setting.key'` edits one key inside a JSON-valued setting and saves the whole setting back. A field with `scope: true` is never saved: its value fills `{key}` in the urls, and a change reads the section again. `default` stands in for a value that is missing or empty. A switch reads `1`/`true`/`yes`/`on` as on and saves `trueValue`/`falseValue` when declared. A secret says it is stored from `setKey` when the server answers that under another key. A `lines` field edits a list one entry per line and saves it as a list, or as JSON text with `saveAs: 'json'`. `visibleWhen` is `{ key, equals?, notEquals?, in?, empty? }` (or a list of them, all of which must hold) over the form and the values read; a hidden field is not checked. An action posts the `send` fields to `url` with `method` (default POST) and shows the answer at `resultPath` (default `message`), as an error when `okPath` reads false; without a sentence there it says `successText` (or `failureText` when `okPath` reads false), `{name}` filled from the answer; with `fill: { key, bytes }` it puts a random value in that field instead. `key` names the setting; a dotted key reads a nested value and is written as written. A field with its own `url` is read there (at `valuePath`, default its key) and saved to its `saveUrl` (default that `url`) with `saveMethod` (default POST) under `saveKey` (default its key), with `saveParams` merged into the body, so one section can hold the settings of several apps. A target under `/ocs/` is sent the `OCS-APIRequest` header. An `image` uploads at once to `uploadUrl`. Labels, hints, placeholders and messages go through the app's translate function. |
